The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that only vague allegations had been made against the petitioners in regard to the demand of dowry and the same are not sufficient to constitute the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC') against the petitioners.
2. He submits that no specific instance has been alleged against the petitioners in regard to offence under Section 498A of the IPC.
3. He further submits that Section 304 of the IPC is added in the present case as appropriate treatment was allegedly not provided to the deceased.
4. He submits that the deceased was married to the brother of the petitioners and she was pregnant.
